items.title: Apollo limits redemptions as withdrawal requests hit 14.7% - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- Apollo Global Management LLC (NYSE:APO) is limiting redemptions from its flagship private credit fund for the third consecutive quarter, as investors continue a broader retreat from the direct lending market. The private equity firm notified shareholders on Tuesday that it will cap quarterly withdrawals from Apollo Debt Solutions BDC at 5% of outstanding shares after receiving redemption requests totaling 14.7% of its stock, according to Bloomberg reporting on a letter to invest

items.title: From the Yankees to the Lakers: What's behind the sports investing boom
items.summary: Apollo Global Management (APO) is reportedly in talks to take a 16% stake in MLB's New York Yankees, the latest move in a growing trend of private equity firms taking stakes in professional sports teams.  The Champion Fund founder and portfolio manager Nick Edward joins Market Domination host Josh Lipton to discuss why so many more firms are looking at sports as a route for high returns, and if any franchises are being overvalued because of it.  Disclosure: Yahoo is a portfolio company of funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management.
